title: God Walks With Us To The End
verse: He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for I will make you into a great nation there. I will go down with you to Egypt and I myself will certainly bring you back from there. Joseph will close your eyes.
observation: While the Bible does not say this specifically, it’s possible to wonder if Jacob thought he could have been leaving God behind. During this time in history, many people believed there were gods everywhere and they all occupied certain geographical regions. This is another reason why it was such a big deal for Abraham to leave everything and go to an unknown land. In his mind, it could have been truly stepping out into a vulnerable place. It is possible that God is reminding Jacob that He is not bound by a certain place. He will not leave Jacob as he goes into a new area. God will go with Jacob and be with him even to the point of death. This is a great reminder for us. God is not bound by space and time. There is nowhere we can go that He does not go with us. He is there. He will continue to walk with us. He goes with us through it all, all the way to the end and beyond.
application: How would your day change if you realized there is nowhere you will go that God will not go, too?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us through every season and situation of life.
